title.en: An Act Declaring June 17 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the Municipality of Magsaysay, Province of Davao del Sur, in Commemoration of its Foundation Anniversary, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Declaring June 17 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the Municipality of Magsaysay, Province of Davao del Sur, in Commemoration of its Foundation Anniversary, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 17 tháng 6 hằng năm là ngày làm việc lễ đặc biệt tại Đô thị Magsaysay, Tỉnh Davao del Sur, nhân kỷ niệm Ngày Thành lập của địa phương, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 17 มิถุนายนของทุกปีเป็นวันทำงานพิเศษในเทศบาล Magsaysay จังหวัด Davao del Sur เนื่องในโอกาสวันสถาปนา และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 17 Juni setiap tahun sebagai hari kerja khusus di Kotamadya Magsaysay, Provinsi Davao del Sur, dalam rangka memperingati Hari Jadi, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 17 Jun setiap tahun sebagai hari bekerja khas di Perbandaran Magsaysay, Wilayah Davao del Sur, sempena memperingati Hari Penubuhan, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: June 17 of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday in the Municipality of Magsaysay, Province of Davao del Sur, in commemoration of its foundation anniversary. However, upon proclamation of the President, June 17 of every year shall be a special non-working holiday in the Municipality of Magsaysay, Province of Davao del Sur.
- This Act shall become effective fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
